summary: 45-year-old Denver woman Kelly Guzman, missing ~10 days after driving into the mountains; her SUV was found stuck in a remote creek bed. She waited 3 days at the car, then walked out barefoot for 8 days through Arapaho National Forest, disoriented after missing daily medications. Found alive behind a bush near the Williams Fork River by a Grand County SAR field team, dehydrated and hypothermic with frostbitten feet and ~30 lbs lost; carried out by piggyback and litter and hospitalized in Denver.
location: Williams Fork River area, Arapaho National Forest
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue; Grand County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date approximate: rescue date estimated from the June-24-2010 Backpacker/CBS4 report (subject already hospitalized and recovering; ~10-11-day ordeal per both accounts). Bear tracks noted near her footprints. She had gone into the woods without telling anyone.
